is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles species in Dielmo, Senegal: 'Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles funestus sensu stricto were found to be the main vectors biting humans' (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No insecticide resistance markers were genotyped in this study. The paper only evaluated species identification (IMPs PCR) and Plasmodium sporozoite infection (ELISA-CSP); mention of kdr on page 6 is purely a discussion citation to previous literature (Thiaw et al. 2018 [33]).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No resistance marker genotyping was performed, so no genotype or allele data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected using human landing catches in Dielmo, Fatick region, Senegal in 2015 (page 2, 'Study area' and 'Field study and laboratory processing of mosquitoes').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary field study investigating vector biting patterns and malaria transmission dynamics in Dielmo in 2015.

sub_country_location.evidence: Village of Dielmo, Fatick region, Senegal (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling conducted from January 2015 through December 2015 (page 2).

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; paper does not conduct insecticide resistance marker assays.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated nocturnal and diurnal biting patterns, species composition, and Plasmodium falciparum sporozoite rates of Anopheles mosquitoes in Dielmo, Senegal in 2015. No insecticide resistance target-site markers were genotyped, rendering the paper ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped or reported (reports_target_markers is false).
No extractable resistance marker genotype data are reported (reports_extractable_genotype_data is false).
